scope: Credential-free EntityOS source provenance staging reproducibility; ordinary deterministic debugging only, no second unusual experiment.

grf.hypothesis: A credential-free source stage can be bound to the exact committed Git tree and made byte-reproducible without transferring repository credentials or ambient checkout bytes.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: The provenance package contains archive metadata or Git metadata whose serialization varies between otherwise identical build invocations, so an equal head/tree does not imply equal staged bytes.
grf.discriminator: Run the stage twice for the exact same committed head/tree and compare raw tar/archive digests and byte counts before any Sandbox execution.
grf.observed_outcome: V3 failed the discriminator: both digest and size differed across the two Vercel build invocations.

repair_candidate.change: Archive the resolved Git tree object rather than the commit object, bind source_head -> source_tree separately, add tar_sha256, retain fixed mtime and gzip -n, and exclude Git metadata/untracked checkout bytes.

parallel_fusion.interpretation: The current shared blocker is reproducible credential-free provenance attestation, not merely deterministic source payload bytes. Prefer the strongest fresh-main provenance lane; do not create parallel canonical mechanisms.

experiment_accounting.note: This receipt records ordinary reproducibility checks and a deterministic repair candidate only.

next_falsifier: Let the exact v4 staging deployment execute if selected by the existing Vercel queue and require two byte-identical tar/archive digests for the same head/tree. Independently prefer the fresh-current-main credential-free attestation lane when it becomes runnable. Only after a provenance mechanism is reproducible and fail-closed should one exact-head isolated Vercel Sandbox rebuild and execute EntityOS with provenance negative controls, PATH-without-host-Python, relocation, exact SHA256 and Sandbox stop evidence.
